cards.name: Beginner wood crafts listed on /ah (barrels, crafting tables, boats, buttons, pressure plates, raw wood stacks)
cards.source: fandom/Money_Making_Tutorial.json (DonutSMP Fandom wiki, page 'Money Making Tutorial', pageid 189; anonymous wiki editors; no upload date, later edits reference the sell multiplier being gone so the page was touched after June 2026)
cards.claim_date: unknown (page edited after the June 2026 sell-multiplier removal)
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: not stated; per-item prices only
cards.process: /rtp from spawn. Get wood and stone tools (/rtp again if no wood nearby). Mine logs and craft them into barrels. Before listing, open /ah and search barrels; list below the lowest current price (if barrels are 10k, list at 9.99k). If barrel prices fall below 10k, craft crafting tables (list for 5-10k), then boats, buttons and pressure plates. If none of these yields 10k+ per item, list individual stacks of wood for 20-100k. Use '/ah sell <price>' with the item in hand instead of listing via the GUI each time.
quotes: Start mining logs and crafting them into barrels which sell for 10-20k each, BUT check them FIRST on /ah barrels and make sure to list them below the lowest price (e.g. if barrels are 10k, sell them for 9.99k)

If barrel prices are below 10k, then craft crafting tables which list for 5-10k, then boats, buttons and pressure plates. If none of these methods yield 10k+ per item, you can sell individual stacks of wood for 20-100k. ALWAYS list below the lowest price.
TIP: Instead of manually listing each item, you can type in /ah sell (desired price) to be more efficent.
tricks: ALWAYS list below the lowest price on /ah (undercut by a cent-level margin: 10k -> 9.99k)
Check the /ah price of the product BEFORE crafting it
Product ladder when one crashes: barrels -> crafting tables -> boats -> buttons -> pressure plates -> raw wood stacks
/ah sell <price> lists the held item without walking the GUI
cards.risks: Undercutting wars; AH prices drift; each listing consumes one of the 18 default AH slots.
cards.scalability: Limited by 18 default AH slots (45 Donut+, 90 Donut++/+++) and by manual log gathering; a Shard Axe (tree-feller, 3k shards) would multiply wood throughput but self-destructs after 1 day.
cards.still_valid_after_june_2026_update: yes - /ah still exists; only change is default slots cut from 25 to 18 (fandom/June_2nd_update.json)
verification_items: Live /ah lowest price for barrels, crafting tables, boats, buttons, pressure plates, wood stacks
/worth barrel and /worth oak_log base prices as the /sell floor

cards.name: TNT crafting from ordered sand and gunpowder
cards.source: fandom/Money_Making_Tutorial.json (Fandom 'Money Making Tutorial', pageid 189); creeper-spawner note from fandom/Spawner.json (pageid 182)
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: not stated; TNT 'sells for 100k-200k for each stack'
cards.setup_time: wait for orders to be delivered (orders stay open about 24 hours)
cards.process: With 200k, open /order and place buy orders for four stacks of sand and four stacks of gunpowder. Search each item, set the /orders sort to 'most money per item' and, because you are the buyer, make your offer the HIGHEST (a dollar or even a cent above the existing top offer) so sellers fill yours first. When everything is delivered (claim at any time during the order), craft sand + gunpowder into TNT and sell TNT by the stack. Creeper spawners are an alternative gunpowder source (the spawner tier list places 'Creeper Spawners (tnt)' in tier A).

inputs.unit_price: not stated; bid a cent above top order
not stated; bid a cent above top order

quotes: When you get 200k, you should make an order (/order) for four stacks of sand and gunpowder. Search up the individual items, and set the /orders setting to most money per item. However, unlike for the auction house, make sure your offer is the highest rather than the lowest, so make it a dollar or even a cent higher than the existing top offers. After everything is delivered, craft the materials into TNT, which sells for 100k-200k for each stack.
tricks: Sort /orders by 'most money per item' to see the top bid
As a buyer, outbid the top order by a dollar or even a cent (the mirror of undercutting on /ah)
Creeper spawner as a gunpowder source instead of buying it
Recipe: 5 gunpowder + 4 sand = 1 TNT (vanilla), so 4 stacks of each is gunpowder-limited
cards.risks: Orders may fill slowly or not at all; TNT price on /ah can be undercut; capital tied up ~24h.
cards.scalability: Limited by gunpowder supply on /orders and by 18 default order slots; TNT resale limited by AH slots.
cards.still_valid_after_june_2026_update: yes - /orders and /ah unchanged except slot counts (18 default)
verification_items: Live top /orders bid for sand and gunpowder

cards.name: Ocean-floor enchanting base: enchant diamond pickaxes and helmets, then book-enchanted helmets
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: not stated
cards.setup_time: build a hidden base under the ocean floor at Y -50 to -55
cards.process: At 1m, make a permanent base: /rtp until next to an ocean, boat/swim to the middle of the ocean, dig down to Y -50 to -55 and build there. Buy bookshelves, an enchantment table and a grindstone; order diamonds if you have none. Enchant diamond pickaxes and helmets and sell them. Repeat to 10m. Then mass-order Protection IV, Unbreaking 3 and Mending books and apply them to helmets ('far more efficient'). Repeat to 20m. At 300m+ the guide says to dismantle the enchant system in favour of elytra flipping and kelp farms.

outputs.item: Enchanted diamond helmets (Prot IV / Unb 3 / Mending)

quotes: RTP again until you're next to an ocean. Buy a boat and swim into the ocean. (best to bring cows with you if you have infinite time). Wait till you're in the middle of the ocean, then dig down to Y -50 to -55 to make your new home!
Buy bookshelves, an enchantment table and a grindstone. If you don't have diamonds, order them. Enchant diamond pickaxes and helmets. Repeat till you're at 10m!
Mass order protection IV books, unbreaking 3 books and mending books. Enchant helmets now - its far more efficent. Repeat until you're at 20m
tricks: Base under mid-ocean floor at Y -50 to -55 to avoid base hunters
Grindstone to strip bad enchants and retry
Mass-order the three books (Protection IV, Unbreaking 3, Mending) rather than rolling the table
Helmets are the efficient target for book enchanting
cards.risks: Base raids (hackers with ESP), enchanted-book price swings, AH slot limits.
cards.scalability: Limited by book supply on /orders, XP, and 18 AH slots.
cards.still_valid_after_june_2026_update: yes - nothing in the method depended on removed features
verification_items: Live /orders price of diamonds, Protection IV / Unbreaking 3 / Mending books
Live /ah price of enchanted diamond helmets and pickaxes

cards.name: Dried kelp farm (RavvixSMP design, 'current meta') selling dried kelp blocks into /orders
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: not stated; '$27.6 on /orders' per item and 'Depends on bone order, usually ~3 times more money' in the methods table
cards.capital_required: not stated (pistons, redstone, hoppers, smokers, observers)
cards.setup_time: '~5 to 20 minutes, depends on model (to build)' (per module)
cards.process: Grow kelp in vertical water columns; pistons constantly powered by redstone break the kelp when it grows into the piston area; water streams carry the drops to hoppers placed above smokers; smokers smelt kelp into dried kelp; craft dried kelp into dried kelp blocks. Sell dried kelp blocks in bulk through /orders (buyers purchase large quantities at once). AFK the farm; add more modules over time (the tutorial says build more kelp farm modules at 300m-1b). Use the Kelpulator (https://kelpulator.vercel.app/) to estimate kelp production, smelting output, block totals and earnings before building. Removed variant: /sell dried kelp blocks at $300 base with a 2.5x+ sell multiplier (see the sell multiplier card).

outputs.item: Dried kelp (farm output as listed in methods table)

quotes: Use RavvixSMP's tutorial on a kelp farm (current meta)
Dried Kelp farm | ~5 to 20 minutes, depends on model (to build) | $27.6 on /orders | Depends on bone order, usually ~3 times more money
Players commonly sell dried kelp blocks through orders, where buyers purchase large quantities at once.

Because Dried Kelp Blocks are sold on /sell for $300 each with a 1.0x multiplier. This means that if you have over a 2.5x multi, you will get profit by ordering the blocks and simply clicking sell all. LrexTTV uses this method and has sold $15T worth in dried kelp blocks.
Build cheap item farming farms (like kelp farms) later, as prices probably won't tank that much after the expansion.
tricks: Pistons constantly powered by redstone (no observer clock needed) harvest kelp as it grows into the piston
Water streams carry drops into hoppers placed above smokers
Smokers, not furnaces, for faster smelting
Craft dried kelp into blocks (9:1) to compress before delivering to orders
Kelpulator calculator to size the farm before building
Build in modules and keep AFKing; add modules as capital grows
Kelp farms are 'cheap item' farms whose prices should survive the border expansion, so build them later rather than before
cards.risks: Needs an AFK player; hackers/raids; order price for kelp blocks can fall; '$27.6' is per item and the 'depends on bone order' profit note is ambiguous.
cards.scalability: Block limits of 20,000 per type (hoppers, dispensers, barrels; chests unlimited) cap module count; /orders demand for dried kelp blocks; smoker throughput.
cards.still_valid_after_june_2026_update: yes for /orders selling; the /sell multiplier variant is dead (sell multiplier removed 2026-06-02)

cards.name: Skeleton spawner bone/arrow farm in many small piles, bones sold into big /orders
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: not stated in money; rate cap 1505.35 bones per minute per pile
cards.capital_required: 1,500 shards per skeleton spawner (old price 500 shards); 3 free via /medal
cards.process: Place skeleton spawners; they produce bones and arrows into an internal inventory opened by right-click (no entities spawn; Smart Spawners plugin). Stacking spawners in one block (shift + right-click) raises output with diminishing returns: bones per minute for x spawners in one pile = -0.39567e^(-0.00134606x+8.24358)+1505.35 (fandom) or approximately -1499.8 e^(-0.00134606x) + 1505.35 (donutpedia), asymptote 1505.35 bones/min. Adding a spawner to a 2-pile adds 2.3 bones/min; adding to a 1,000-pile adds 0.9 bones/min. So spread spawners into many piles: piles only need to be different blocks, even 2 blocks apart. Bones have 'huge orders' (unlike piglin heads). Tutorial warns AFKing spawners is NOT recommended now because ESP hackers find them within a day.
quotes: Keeping spawners in multiple piles give more bones

There is an equation for how many bones skeleton spawners make per minute. The equation is "-0.39567e^{\left(-0.00134606x+8.24358\right)}+1505.35". ... The horizontal asymptote (aka how many bones per minute spawners can make in one stack) is at 1505.35

Visualize two spawner piles - one has only two spawners, so adding another will add 2.3 bones per minute to the total production. If we already have 1,000 spawners in the pile and we add one more, that same spawner we add will only add 0.9 bones per minute

Spawners are considered as in different piles as long as they aren't in the same block. You don't need them to be many chunks apart, you only need them to be separated. They can just be 2 blocks next to each other.
The only limitation they have is the fact that there aren't huge orders for them like there are for bones.
AFKing spawners: Right now, hackers roam the server freely, so if you AFK any spawners, they will most likely be gone within one day.
tricks: Shift + right-click to stack same-type spawners in one block, up to the signed 32-bit integer limit
Spread into many piles 2 blocks apart to escape the per-pile diminishing-returns curve
Use Donut+/Donut++ extra homes (9/27/90) to spread spawners over more locations so a raid does not take everything
Bones sell into large standing /orders (bulk liquidity)
cards.risks: Spawners are 'pie-chartable' and ESP-visible below deepslate; raids lose everything; shards cost real money now.
cards.scalability: Per-pile asymptote 1505.35 bones/min; number of piles and homes; block limits do not apply to spawners as stated but hoppers/barrels cap at 20,000.

mechanics_facts.fact: Three sell channels: any item (except spawners) can be sold on the Auction House (/ah), delivered on Orders (/orders) or sold to the server with /sell at a default sell price that usually stays constant (exceptions: events like the carved pumpkin Halloween event, and the now-removed personal sell multiplier).

/sell is marked 'NOT RECOMMENDED' by the wiki; it opens a chest GUI and everything inside is sold at Base price when the GUI is closed. /sellhistory shows previous /sell sales. /worth <item> shows an item's Base price; omitting the item opens a GUI listing all items.
Prices are generally cheaper on /orders than on /ah, though not always; /orders is an automated bulk buy/deliver system and fills may take time.

Orders: players list an order for a quantity and a price per item; delivered items can be picked up at any time during the order; orders are open for about 24 hours and after an order concludes the owner has 90 hours to claim the items. Commands: /order or /orders <search>.
/orders has a sort setting 'most money per item'; as a buyer your order should be the HIGHEST (a dollar or a cent above the top offer), the mirror of undercutting on /ah.
Non-Donut+ players have 18 Auction House slots and 18 Orders slots since the June 2nd 2026 update (previously 25). Donut+: 45 AH and 45 order slots. Donut++ and Donut+++: 90 AH and 90 order slots.
Homes: non-Donut+ 3 (was 2; some ex-team players got 4); Donut+ 9 max (3 default + 6); Donut++ 27; Donut+++ 90. Unsubscribing keeps existing homes but blocks setting new ones.

Rank prices: Donut+ $5.01 USD/month; Donut++ $10.03 USD/month; Donut+++ $15.05 USD/month (30 days per payment). Donut+++ adds priority chunk generation. Media rank lasts 90 days with Donut+++ perks; requirements: 25 avg concurrent viewers on Twitch/YouTube longform live, or 100 on TikTok/YouTube Shorts live, or 5k views on a YouTube video, or 50k views on a TikTok / YouTube Short / Instagram Reel, content about DonutSMP with the server IP on screen, analytics proof, ticket at support.donutsmp.net.

Donut+ perks listed: /hide (username scramble; command removed June 2026), shards without AFK (must still be online), special name mark, fast auction purchasing, higher tab-list position, lobby flight (/fly removed June 2026), faster tpa/tp cooldowns.

mechanics_facts.fact: Auction House GUI: bottom chest to sell (empty map to pick item, green glass to continue, sign to type the price, green glass to confirm); hopper icon filters by item type; sign icon searches; anvil reloads; cauldron sorts Highest Price / Lowest Price / Recently Listed; arrows page. Commands /ah, /auction, (formerly /shop); '/auction sell <price>' (also written '/ah sell <price>') lists the held item with a confirmation dialog. Items can be sold in bulk via shulker boxes.

June 2nd 2026 update (server down ~12 hours): /shop removed, spawn removed, sell multiplier removed, teams removed (replaced by Friends/Following), duels removed, Billford removed, crates/keys removed, AFK lobby and AFK shards removed, shards no longer granted on kills, Donut++ and Donut+++ added, Shard Shop added (accessed through the /ah or /orders GUI), dialog UI replaces chest GUIs (1.21.6 dialogs), new minimal scoreboard (balance, shards, kills, deaths, playtime), RTP and homes teleport instantly instead of a 5-second delay, RTP cooldown 15 seconds, staff shown with a colored star in tab. Removed commands: /billford /fly /hide /sellmulti /spectate /team /warp /world. Donutpedia dates it June 3rd 2026.

Old spawner shard prices before the shard-shop repricing: Pig 250, Cow 350, Spider 750, Zombified Piglin 400, Skeleton 500, Blaze 1000, Creeper 625, Iron Golem 1500; all now 1500.
Old shard-shop keys (removed with crates): Common Key 200 shards, Crimson Key 2,500, Prime Key 2,500. Old crate keys: Common (hourly and purchasable), Prime, Gold, Amethyst, Crimson.

Shard/Amethyst items self-destruct 1 day after purchase (formerly 3 days). They can be sold, purchased and listed on /ah but cannot be ordered. Losing one to the timer is described as losing 15-20 million. Shard Pickaxe ('drill') breaks up to nine blocks at once with maxed-netherite speed and durability; Shard Axe fells the entire tree including leaves; Shard Shovel behaves like the pickaxe; Amethyst Shard Booster gave 4x AFK shards for 24 hours (moot since AFK shards were removed); Amethyst Bucket (drained 27 water) removed. The Amethyst Crate that used to give them is removed.

Spawners produce drops without spawning entities (Smart Spawners plugin); right-click opens the drop inventory like a chest. Eight types: Pig (porkchop), Cow (beef, no leather), Spider (spider eye + string), Zombified Piglin (gold nugget), Skeleton (bone + arrow), Blaze (blaze powder, not rods), Creeper (gunpowder), Iron Golem (iron ingot); the old shop also listed a Zombie spawner.

Spawner stacking: shift + right-click stacks same-type spawners in one block up to the signed 32-bit integer limit; output per pile follows bones/min = -0.39567e^(-0.00134606x+8.24358)+1505.35 (fandom) ~= -1499.8e^(-0.00134606x)+1505.35 (donutpedia, 'ref needed'), x = spawners in the pile, horizontal asymptote 1505.35 bones/min per pile. Marginal spawner adds 2.3 bones/min at a 2-pile and 0.9 bones/min at a 1,000-pile. Separate piles only need to be different blocks (2 blocks apart counts).

Spawners cannot be sold on /ah, /orders or /sell; they change hands only through third-party trading (scam risk). Wiki price $5.7M-$10M each. Spawners are 'pie-chartable' (findable via the F3 pie chart) and visible to ESP hackers below deepslate; AFKing spawners is 'NOT recommended currently' because they are 'most likely gone within one day'. /medal rewards 3 skeleton spawners for completing the medal quest.

Block limits: most blocks capped at 20,000 per player, including hoppers, dispensers and barrels; chests are unlimited.

Server rules (cheats/clients): no hacked clients, movement mods, inventory mods, health indicators, radar, freecam, ESP, auto/easy place, macros or scripts, auto clickers, mouse tweaks/scrollers, crafting modifications. Exploits: no bug abuse, no attempted or actual duplication, no finding/using the seed. Economy: no IRL trading, no external gambling, no cross-server trading, no invite rewards, no Discord boost rewards. Accounts: no staff impersonation, no more than 5 accounts. Punishments: mutes, temp bans, player data wipes for dupers.

IRL spending from third-party sites is bannable; only store.donutsmp.net is allowed. External gambling and hack Discords are banned; never use referral codes; use an alt if you must join such a Discord. DrDonut bans accounts suspected of being AFK bots, so Donut+ alts used to AFK farms should be played on.

World border: 225,000 blocks from (0,0) in each direction; expansion to 30,000,000 speculated within the next 2 years (W1zox live stream 2026-07-24). Reason for delay: cost of physical servers, which is why the shard shop / p2w features were added (DrDonutt).

Border expansion advice: sell all expensive items before it expands; bases become virtually unraidable afterwards so do not build new bases until it fully expands; build expensive-item farms (mob heads) now and cheap-item farms (kelp) later. Expected to tank: elytras, dragon heads, netherite blocks/ingots/scraps, ancient debris, netherite armor/tools/trims, gilded blackstone, deepslate emerald, enchanted golden apples (dips can happen earlier and recover). Expected to hold: all diamond items, music discs, all mob heads. Expected to rise: all spawners, everything from the old /shop, trial-chamber items (tridents, maces, wind burst books), diamond nautilus shells.

Dried kelp block /sell base price was $300 at 1.0x; the profitable sell-multiplier threshold for ordering blocks and selling them was above 2.5x; LrexTTV reportedly sold $15T of dried kelp blocks that way.

Kelp farm mechanics: kelp grows upward in water columns; constantly powered pistons break it; water streams carry drops to hoppers above smokers; smokers produce dried kelp; crafted into dried kelp blocks. Kelpulator (https://kelpulator.vercel.app/) estimates production and earnings.
Money inflates heavily because of the growing player base and demand for rare items; elytras rose over 3000x in a year; money 'holds no actual investment value' so players hold finite items.

Other commands relevant to trading: /pay <player> <amount> (cannot exceed balance); /bounty <player> and /bounty add <player> <amount> (depletes your balance); /baltop <page>; /bal <player>; /tpa, /tpahere, /tpauto (auto-accept teleport requests); /findplayer (/fp) shows a player's dimension; /rtp <region> (instant, 15 s cooldown); /sethome, /home, /delhome; /api and /api revoke for an API key.
